profile_text.body:
Serve Robotics describes itself as building self-driving robots for last-mile delivery, framing the work as a low-emissions alternative to moving small items by car. Its site asks why a 2-pound burrito should be moved in a 2-ton car, and says the company is setting a standard for safety on and beyond the sidewalk while protecting customer data, employees, and the public. The site names one robot, Saymo, and says that when it is not delivering burritos it appears as John Mulaney's sidekick on the show "Everybody's Live."

The company is a public company traded under the ticker SERV, with SEC CIK 0001832483, headquartered in San Carlos, California. Its own site presents it as a sustainable delivery company rather than describing a broader product line, and no specific products or MCP servers are listed among the facts held about it. No litigation is listed either.
